title: Find a compact healthcare-record corpus packet
description: Find and pin a compact, complete, permissively licensed healthcare source scope with patient/person/address or clinical-record semantics distinct from current identity and commerce packets. Prepare scanner-blind proposed annotations and a human review worksheet; do not accept labels without review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Research result: OpenMRS PatientIdentifier.java is a compact 380-line, source-authored healthcare candidate whose documentation explicitly covers medical record numbers, social-security numbers, and driver licenses. Its source declares MPL-2.0, so it is held as a strong candidate pending the same authorized corpus-use/license decision required for weak-copyleft material; no annotation packet was created.
